name: PDF Viewer
description: Demo interactive PDF viewer that renders PDFs from a limited set of allowed URLs (e.g., arxiv.org) for security reasons.

_published_faq.name: How do I add PDF Viewer to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add PDF Viewer to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://example-server.modelcontextprotocol.io/pdf/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the PDF Viewer MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: PDF Viewer provides these MCP tools: display_pdf.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to PDF Viewer?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to PDF Viewer in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does PDF Viewer MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: PDF Viewer requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
PDF Viewer is developed by Model Context Protocol Community. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
